page.content:
Conveyor-belt sushi — plates on a belt, a postwar casual form.

How Kaiten-zushi connects

  • Character: Yoshiaki Shiraishi — Yoshiaki Shiraishi invented conveyor-belt sushi in Osaka.
  • Location: Osaka — The first kaiten-zushi shop opened in Osaka.
  • Topic: Sushi — Conveyor-belt service is a casual form of sushi, not a different cuisine.

What is Kaiten-zushi?

Kaiten-zushi, credited to Yoshiaki Shiraishi in Osaka in 1958, put maki and nigiri on a conveyor so sushi could be a self-serve lunch, not only a counter craft.

Key threads lead to Yoshiaki Shiraishi, Osaka and Sushi.
